verdict.rationale: Babylon.js documents its own production renderer: 'best-in-class' PBR materials, clustered lighting, a scene graph with lights and materials, a Node Material Editor, and WebGL 1/2 and WebGPU back ends. The evidence pack does not cover shadows, global illumination or baked lighting, or post-processing, so only part of the story is evidenced. missing for 10: documented shadow support, global illumination or baked lightmap support, a post-processing pipeline, and independent hands-on corroboration of rendering quality.

support.subject: As a game developer, the engine ships a modern production 3D renderer — PBR materials, global illumination or baked lighting, shadows, post-processing

citations.quote: Learn more about Clustered Lighting in Babylon.js
Provides a complete scene graph with lights, cameras, materials, meshes, sprites, layers, animations, audio clips, GUI elements, and actions
Runs on WebGL 1.0, WebGL 2.0, and WebGPU platforms
